newsitem.title: ISRAEL: IMF seen upgrading Israel to industrialised economy.
newsitem.headline: IMF seen upgrading Israel to industrialised economy.

text.p: The Bank of Israel said on Tuesday that the International Monetary Fund (IMF) would begin in April to classify Israel as an industrialised nation.

"The IMF announced that in the light of rapid changes in the economic characteristics and per capita income in certain countries, it was decided to include Israel, South Korea, Singapore, Hong Kong and Taiwan in the group of industrialised nations," the central bank said in a statement.

It said the IMF took the decision after an appeal by the Bank of Israel, which said that Israel met all the criteria of an industrialised nation and deserved to be included in the group of 23 countries that already hold the classification.

"The Bank of Israel hopes that Israel's inclusion in this group of industrialised nations will have a positive effect on its standing and rating in international markets -- depending of course on economic policy and developments," the statement said.
